ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has appointed Mr. Nikhil Dhingra as (Joint) Managing Director and CEO for a five-year term, effective October 3, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. This move formalizes the leadership of a key executive credited with substantial achievements including successful fundraising, a credit rating upgrade, and significant expansion of the company's renewable energy portfolio and financials. No material red flags are immediately apparent, suggesting a strong vote of confidence in his continued strategic direction.
